text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho, the first leg 
of the Triple Crown. Amid the public's 
soaring anticipation for the three-way 
showdown between Seiun Sky, Special Week, 
and King Halo—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for Seiun Sky herself, of all things, 
she was playing with cats in the park and 
nearly ended up late!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she wasn't just fooling around 
either. Even as she fixed a deadly serious 
gaze upon her rivals—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Along with a picture of a cat, the message 
sent to her grandfather was accompanied by 
the words: "I'm bringing home the crown."
